reason: The README describes a Tauri desktop launcher that installs and manages Node.js and DeepSeek Harness, controls a local server, runs system commands, stays in the tray, and opens Harness in an embedded browser; these system-level capabilities warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 鲸仔是一款面向普通用户的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面助手，可引导安装依赖、管理本地服务并在内置窗口中打开 Harness。
summaries.en: Whalito is a desktop assistant for DeepSeek Harness that guides dependency installation, manages the local service, and opens Harness in an embedded window.

capabilities: Detects and installs or upgrades Node.js and DeepSeek Harness dependencies
Downloads packages from npm sources and Node.js distribution sources
Starts, stops, restarts, and monitors a local Harness server process
Runs shell and system commands for installation, version checks, process control, and startup configuration
Creates user-level startup configuration and maintains a system tray application
Opens Harness in an embedded browser window and supports application updates
